title: Outbox retries: plan for feat/outbox
state: 5 tasks in 3 waves. The plan is hardened and ready to run.

panels.caption: A row goes to the sender, and back on failure.

steps.say: The app writes each event to an outbox row.
The sender reads a row and posts it.
If the post fails, the row waits and tries again.

rows.why: One row holds all state for one event.
It spares a service that is down.
A person can inspect parked rows later.
